Fire Ring Race'' |author=[[Ryder Windham]] |cover artist=[[Robert Rath]] |illustrator=Robert Rath |editor= |publisher=[[Scholastic]] |early release= |release date=[[June]] [[2010]]{{SWArchive|url=kids/read/firering_race/index.html|text=Read Some of ''Star Wars'': Adventures in Hyperspace: ''Fire Ring Race'' Now!}} |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Paperback |pages=96 |isbn=9780545213585 |isbn2= |isbn3= |timeline= |series=''[[Star Wars: Adventures in Hyperspace]]'' |preceded by=''[[Rebel Dawn]]'' |followed by=[[Adventures in Hyperspace: Shinbone Showdown|''Shinbone Showdown'']] }} '''''Adventures in Hyperspace: Fire Ring Race''''' is the first volume in the ''[[Star Wars: Adventures in Hyperspace]]'' [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] young-reader series, which follows the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] in the employ of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] prior to the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. ''Fire Ring Race'' was written by [[Ryder Windham]], illustrated by [[Robert Rath]], and published by [[Scholastic]] in [[June]] [[2010]].
